name: HEGROUP
recent: HE Group Berhad 近期公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收与净利均大幅增长，主要受数据中心需求带动。同时，董事经理 Haw Chee Seng 在 11 月多次增持公司股份，包括在闭门期内的交易。
notable: 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收同比增长 81.82% 至 RM58.72 million，净利 RM5.17 million。
董事经理 Haw Chee Seng 在 11 月多次增持公司股份。
risks: 董事经理在闭门期内进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM46.14 million，环比增长 75.8%，同比增长 44.0%；净利为 RM5.10 million，环比增长 99.2%，同比增长 61.3%；净利率为 11.1%，高于上一季度的 9.8%。

recent_en: HE Group Berhad recently announced its 3Q2026 results, with revenue and net profit both rising sharply, driven mainly by data centre demand. Meanwhile, Managing Director Haw Chee Seng acquired shares multiple times in November, including trades during the closed period.
notable_en: Announced 3Q2026 results with revenue up 81.82% YoY to RM58.72 million and net profit of RM5.17 million.
Managing Director Haw Chee Seng acquired shares multiple times in November.
risks_en: The Managing Director conducted share trades during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM46.14 million, up 75.8% QoQ and 44.0% YoY; net profit was RM5.10 million, up 99.2% QoQ and 61.3% YoY; net margin was 11.1%, higher than 9.8% in the previous quarter.
